ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the motivations behind the Trump administration's funding freeze for childcare grants and family assistance, and explore the potential consequences for low-income families and children
questions: What are the motivations behind the funding freeze?
How will the funding freeze impact low-income families and children?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a pattern of neglect or disregard for the needs of low-income families and children. By following the money and analyzing data, we may be able to uncover the motivations behind the funding freeze and the potential consequences for those affected
